entries.12dfabf7488038db: It is composed of the company, 32 subsidiaries and 3 associated companies (as of March 31, 2026). The number of consolidated employees is 5,525. Founded in Tokyo in 1913 as Kenzai-sha, it developed mainly through air-conditioning equipment construction.
entries.1308d647f848b667: A facilities construction company that designs, supervises, and builds air conditioning and painting facilities, handling air conditioning for buildings and factories and painting facilities for automobile plants and others in Japan and overseas.
entries.2230bb380c6f4e1d: Operators of buildings, such as offices, hotels, hospitals and data centers
entries.24fdf438db3cfab9: A business that designs, supervises and constructs painting equipment mainly related to the automotive industry, and manufactures and sells related materials and equipment. In addition to painting equipment for automobile bodies and bumpers, it also handles painting equipment in manufacturing plants for construction vehicles, railway vehicles, aircraft and general industrial machinery. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥103,084 million.
entries.2939adcfa30f5306: A business that designs, supervises and constructs building air-conditioning and industrial air-conditioning equipment, and manufactures and sells related materials and equipment. It handles general air-conditioning equipment for offices, hotels, stores, schools, hospitals and data centers, and industrial air-conditioning equipment such as clean rooms in manufacturing plants for semiconductors, electronic components, batteries, precision machinery, pharmaceuticals and food. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥183,043 million.
entries.5296a53a8cbf47f5: In its 10-year plan 2035, disclosed in May 2025, it sets 'Be Engineering for a Sustainable Society' as its desired image for 2035, and under its Purpose of 'Protecting the air, opening up the future,' it has established two guidelines, 'Innovative Engineering' and 'Global Inclusion,' and eight strategic focuses. It is advancing expansion into growth industries such as semiconductors and electronic components, mobility, batteries, pharmaceuticals and data centers, enhancing its global regional strategy in ASEAN and elsewhere, and cultivating customers among non-Japanese companies. It positions the medium-term management plan starting in the fiscal year ended March 2026 as a three-year period of 'Restructuring for Transformation.'
entries.5365477f74bbad83: It provides an integrated service, 'Design, Build & Care,' from design proposals through construction to aftercare, combining 'Green Technology' developed in the fields of energy, air and water with 'Robotics Automation' based on factory automation technology. It utilizes a global network of 30 locations in 20 countries, built over 50 years, and five global R&D bases.
entries.746268020003483a: Its customers include operators of offices, hotels, hospitals and data centers, manufacturing plants for semiconductors, electronic components, pharmaceuticals and food, and automobile manufacturers. Its customers are not limited to Japan: it also receives construction orders from overseas customers in Southeast Asia, North America, India, China and elsewhere.
entries.7857a8072320ed47: Completed construction revenue from air-conditioning equipment construction
entries.89ae6bf99ca6eaf1: These are based on sales to external customers in the segment note, and on sales by region and information by major customer in [Related Information] (fiscal year ended March 2026).
entries.8e27ad41a487ed9f: It secures profit by pursuing expansion of orders and efficiency of construction both in Japan and overseas. Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥15,594 million.
entries.95067435320113ce: In the Environmental Systems Business, it designs, supervises and constructs building air-conditioning equipment and industrial air-conditioning equipment; in the Coating Systems Business, it designs, supervises and constructs coating equipment mainly for the automotive industry. It also manufactures and sells related equipment and materials.

entries.a7d03db62e8e7763: It handles air-conditioning equipment for buildings and factories and painting equipment for the automotive industry, from design, supervision and construction to the manufacture and sale of related equipment and materials, and earns consideration for the completion of construction work.
entries.b5bf69ee9ee73db4: A business that designs, supervises and constructs painting equipment mainly related to the automotive industry, and manufactures and sells related materials and equipment.
entries.be0f980c45c62d2b: Completed construction revenue, earned by completing equipment construction work, is recorded as sales. Sales to external customers by business were ¥183,043 million for the Environmental Systems Business and ¥103,084 million for the Coating Systems Business.
